from arch.data import nasdaq
data = nasdaq.load()
returns = data[["Adj Close"]].pct_change().dropna()

cov_est = Bartlett(returns ** 2)
# Get the long-run covariance
cov_est.cov.long_run

entries.summary: VAR-HAC and Pre-Whitened-Recolored Long-run covariance estimation.

recipe.title: VAR-HAC and Pre-Whitened-Recolored Long-run covariance estimation.
recipe.code:
import numpy as np
from arch.covariance.var import PreWhitenedRecolored
rs = np.random.default_rng(0)
e = rs.standard_normal((1001, 2))
x = e[1:] + 0.5 * e[:-1]
pwrc = PreWhitenedRecolored(x, lags=1, kernel="bartlett", bandwidth=5.0)
lrcov = pwrc.cov.long_run
pwrc.order
resid = pwrc.resid
resid_cov = pwrc.resid_cov
var_hac = PreWhitenedRecolored(x, kernel=None, method="bic")
lrcov = var_hac.cov.long_run
